channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Washington chemical tank was called unfit for service before deadly failure, investigators find
item.description: An inspection contractor found a chemical tank at a Washington state paper mill “not fit for continued service” 10 months before it failed in May, killing 11.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Largo man suffers serious burns after a tire blew on concrete truck on I-75
item.description: FHP said a Largo man was injured after his vehicle experienced tire failure, left the roadway and overturned. The driver suffered serious burns and was transported to Tampa General Hospital.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Should AI be banned from the classroom?
item.description: On this week's episode of Catch me Up, we break down how AI is reshaping education and remember legendary entertainer and philanthropist Dolly Parton.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Congress faces a packed schedule as soon as lawmakers return from recess
item.description: As soon as they return from recess, congressional lawmakers will be racing the clock to pass a short-term government funding bill to avert a pre-election government shutdown.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Fireworks display celebrates Rays stadium deal reached with Tampa, Hillsborough County
item.description: The City of Tampa and the Tampa Bay Rays celebrated the approval of the team's future home with a 10-minute fireworks display on Friday evening at Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Fans, business owners react to Rays leaving St. Pete: 'A big change'
item.description: As the Tampa Bay Rays move closer to a $2.3 billion ballpark in Tampa, St. Pete businesses surrounding Tropicana Field are preparing for a new reality without the team.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Cardiac arrest survivor reunites with St. Petersburg first responders
item.description: Michael Warner had done the St. Anthony’s Triathlon nearly 10 times before, but this year’s race in April was different.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Safety Harbor pier reopens two years after severe hurricane damage
item.description: Two years after three hurricanes forced its closure, the Safety Harbor pier officially reopened to the public.
